methodology.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW for C; std::chrono::steady_clock for oneDNN
methodology.cold_definition: touch the configured cache-scrub buffer at 64-byte intervals immediately before each retained cold sample
methodology.execution_order: compiler-major then configured-lane order for native/dense/OpenBLAS; configured-lane order for oneDNN; every declared case is retained
methodology.host_load_policy: timestamped load observations bracket the competitive measurement window; results are retained without favorable-sample filtering
methodology.iris_external_exactness: X10 values are nonnegative integers <=79 and every dot sum is below 2^24; SGEMM and u8/s8/s32 outputs are exact integers and are compared with the frozen 4x4 oracle
methodology.onednn_saturation_control: two maximum Q8 pair products are 2*63*63=7938 and two maximum Iris pair products are at most 2*79*79=12482, both below s16 saturation; complete dot sums are below s32 overflow
methodology.onednn_thread_policy: oneDNN scaling and QQfenx/oneDNN ratios are published only when the OpenMP runtime is controlled through its API and a separate OpenMP probe region in the comparator process observes the requested team size with dynamic teams disabled; TBB, threadpool, sequential, unknown, or unobserved OpenMP runs retain timings but withhold ratios
methodology.publication_policy: retain every successful sample and every measured compiler/thread variant; abort rather than omit an exactness failure
methodology.q8_openblas_exactness: payloads are in [0,63], every product is exactly representable in f32, every nonnegative dot sum is below 2^24, and reconstructed wrapping-u32 words are compared element-by-element
methodology.ratio_direction: baseline_over_candidate greater than 1 means QQfenx was faster for that retained host measurement
methodology.scope_warning: OpenBLAS and oneDNN comparisons cover only the proven exact-compatible domains; neither library is represented as a general wrapping-u32 implementation
methodology.warm_definition: one unretained warmup followed by consecutive retained samples without explicit cache scrubbing
